# DSH plugins by MingXuanZi
One plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness, published to npm and listed in the DSH plugin market.
| Package | What it does | Category |
| `packages/dsh-extend` | Seven plugins in one: a draggable desktop pet in its own transparent alway
s-on-top window (codex-pets.net marketplace), a global wallpaper consistent across every surface (wa
llhaven.cc or a local file, with Windows titlebar integration), the Session-header "Open In…" split
button with the desktop-build fixes, a codeg-style session tab bar in the window caption, the Window
s chrome region dividers (caption-band bottom edge + sidebar right edge), window-size/maximized memo
ry, and the Default Workspace Suite. | `ui` |
It replaces the deprecated `@qwqweeo123/dsh-pet`, `@qwqweeo123/dsh-wallpaper` and `@qwqweeo123/dsh-o
pen-in-app` packages — install only this one:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install it from **Settings → Plugin Market** (the market maps a repository to its npm package aut
t from **Settings → Plugin Market** (the market maps a repository to its npm package automatically).
